tawang-road-via-sela-pass.title: Tawang Road via Sela Pass
tawang-road-via-sela-pass.slogan: Tezpur to Tawang · one way, about 326 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Tezpur
waypoints.advice: Tezpur is where the day begins. Next is Bomdila.

waypoints.advice: Bomdila comes up 82 km in. Next is Sela Pass.

waypoints.name: Sela Pass
waypoints.advice: 163 km in you reach Sela Pass. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Jaswant Garh, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Tezpur → Bomdila is 96 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Bomdila → Sela Pass climbs about 4170 m in 52 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Sela Pass → Jaswant Garh drops about 4170 m over 13 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Jaswant Garh → Tawang is 20 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

tawang-road-via-sela-pass.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Tawang Road via Sela Pass. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Bomdila → Sela Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 8.1%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter. First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Tawang Road via Sela Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 4170 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Tawang Road via Sela Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: For 36 km this is Tawang Road via Sela Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

tawang-road-via-sela-pass.story: From Tezpur it runs 326 km to Tawang; allow about 4 h 23 of riding. The stops in between: Bomdila, Sela Pass and Jaswant Garh. The highest point is about 4,400 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Orcombe Rocks to Chit Rocks → Dorset and East Devon Coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 28 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-orcombe-rocks-to-chit-rocks-chesi.story: 139 km from Sidmouth to Sidmouth, about 2 h 24 of riding. It goes by way of Dorset and East Devon Coast, Chesil and back through Dorset and East Devon Coast. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
